title: The Body Has Many Uses (1)
subtitle: Body idioms for jokes, plans, and hurrying up.

idioms.mean: joke with someone by telling them something untrue
idioms.ex: Don't worry, I'm just **pulling your leg**. The exam isn't today!

idioms.mean: decide what to do as things happen, without a plan
idioms.ex: We don't have a plan for Saturday yet. Let's just **play it by ear**.
Can you fix my bike chain? I'm **all thumbs** with tools.
**Shake a leg**! The bus leaves in five minutes.

tip: **pull someone's leg** biasanya dipakai dalam bentuk continuous: *I'm just pulling your leg* (aku cuma bercanda). **Shake a leg** adalah perintah santai, jangan dipakai ke guru atau atasan.

meaning.why: Bercanda dengan cerita yang tidak benar.

dialogue.q: A: Our teacher said we have a test every day this week! B: Really?! A: No, I'm just ___.
A: What time should we leave for the beach? B: I'm not sure. Let's ___.
dialogue.why: Belum ada rencana pasti → play it by ear.

dialogue.q: A: Can you sew this button for me? B: Sorry, I'm ___. Ask my mum.
A: The movie starts in ten minutes! ___! B: Okay, okay, I'm coming!

correct.q: "I'm all thumbs, so I'll be careful with your phone."
"My leg hurts because my friend pulled my leg."
correct.why: Salah: pull someone's leg = bercanda, bukan menarik kaki.

correct.q: "We booked everything weeks ago, so we'll play it by ear."
correct.why: Salah: kalau semua sudah direncanakan, bukan play it by ear.

correct.q: "Shake a leg, everyone! The train is leaving!"

speak.q: Do you like to plan your weekends, or do you play it by ear?
speak.model: I usually <mark>play it by ear</mark>. I don't like strict plans, so on Saturday morning I just call my friends and we decide what to do together.
speak.label: play it by ear

speak.q: Are you good with your hands, or are you all thumbs?
speak.model: Honestly, I'm <mark>all thumbs</mark>. I tried to fix my fan last week and I broke it even more, so my dad had to help me.
speak.label: all thumbs

speak.q: Tell me about a time someone pulled your leg.
speak.model: Last April my brother <mark>pulled my leg</mark>. He said our school was closed for a week, and I believed him until my friends texted me!
speak.label: pull someone's leg

roleplay.situation: Kamu dan temanmu sedang bersiap pergi ke acara ulang tahun teman, tapi kalian sudah terlambat.
steps: **Student A:** suruh temanmu cepat (*shake a leg*).
**Student B:** jawab bahwa kamu kesulitan mengikat dasi / memasang jam tangan (*all thumbs*).
**Student A:** bercanda bahwa acaranya sudah selesai, lalu akui kamu bercanda (*pulling your leg*).
**Both:** putuskan mau pulang jam berapa (*let's play it by ear*).
roleplay.target: Target: percakapan 1–2 menit, semua 4 idiom terpakai.
